caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular metal box with a slightly curved lid and a brass or gold-colored handle on top. The box is predominantly black and features decorative elements in gold, red, green, and pink. Along the top edge and lid, there are gold wavy lines and circular patterns. On the front of the box, there are two large, pink-red floral designs with green leaves and yellow accents, as well as a central metallic lock. The left side of the box shows a gold radial or sunburst motif. The box sits against a plain light beige or off-white background, with no additional objects present.
title: Chest
